nativeFigma.identityPolicy: Resolve native identities and current verification status from the manifest; do not cache node IDs here.

componentSets.name: Truthful / Button
componentSets.labelPolicy: Editable instance wording; preserve on Style/State swaps.
componentSets.hoverPolicy: Explicit selectable authored state: Primary uses the root forest-hover color as literal paint; Secondary uses the existing selected color variable. No new native COLOR variable is introduced. Automatic hover prototype behavior is not asserted.

componentSets.name: Truthful / Status
componentSets.labelPolicy: Wording follows State; no free Label property.

nativeFigma.layoutPolicy: Use Fill container for authored matching widths and Hug height for growing text; matching repeated spacing and radius values bind to variables. Separate desktop/mobile compositions remain intentional.

proofScope.masterPropagation: Reversible corner-radius mutation on a linked clone, restored after observation.
proofScope.styleSwap: Primary/Secondary and Disabled inherit main fill and typography while preserving button wording; Status wording follows State.

resize.label: Review the exact action and supporting evidence

proofScope.limitation: Representative clone probes only; not arbitrary-width responsiveness or financial execution.

nativeFigma.verificationPolicy: Read current manifest status/proofs and native gates. This sidecar is system guidance, not proof of native persistence.

editorCanvasLayout.policy: Measure guide/heading heights; reserve native editor-label band and inspect actual Figma window because exports omit those labels.

narrative.overview: Apple-inspired clarity and Ramp-inspired efficiency guide an editable financial review file. Public Sans, quiet neutral surfaces and forest actions preserve the incumbent identity; explicit written states preserve financial meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Separate authored desktop and mobile compositions
Native handoff with precise verification scope

rules.name: The State Has a Name Rule
rules.body: Keep written financial states beside their semantic color.

rules.name: The Connected Control Rule
rules.body: Keep the instance linked: use Label for button wording and Style/State for authored treatment.

dos: Do change a main component for global treatment and instance Label for local button wording.
Do select the actual Status state and retain its wording.
Do inspect desktop, mobile, library and handoff exports after changes.
donts: Do not detach a component to change wording.
Do not communicate financial meaning through color alone.
Do not infer arbitrary-width responsiveness from Auto Layout or the recorded clone probes.
Do not treat review navigation as financial execution.
